result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): The two answers are very close. Each shows the same five episodes side by side, uses a warm near-black background with off-white text, separates cards with subtle borders, and lightens the accent to a coral on dark play buttons. B wins narrowly because its dark cards are a warmer brown-tinted surface that ties back to the cream light theme more clearly. A's dark cards are a more neutral charcoal and its panel looks slightly closer to pure black. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers show matching light and dark panels with softened warm-dark surfaces, subtly bordered cards, readable muted text and a lightened coral accent used only on the play buttons. A's dark panel keeps more of the warm brown tone, and its dark play glyph on the lighter coral reads more clearly. B's white glyph on the lightened coral has slightly weaker contrast, and its dark background leans a bit closer to neutral black.
